# Broad beans after the wet winter

Last January's seed notes helped me avoid the puddled bed. The saved beans emerged unevenly; some could have been damaged in storage. Keep the packet and label both batches. [[Garden notebook]] is useful because it remembers an awkward detail, not because it predicts the weather. The comparison is worth repeating without expecting a verdict this spring.
